```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(cowplot)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2) 


bac.size <- read.delim2(here("00_data", "01_descstats_data", "NCBI_Bacillota_Genomes.tsv"))
bac.size$Organism.Name <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", bac.size$Organism.Name)
bac.size$CheckM.completeness <- as.numeric(bac.size$CheckM.completeness)
bac.size$CheckM.contamination <- as.numeric(bac.size$CheckM.contamination)

bac.size <- subset(bac.size, bac.size$CheckM.completeness>=95 & bac.size$CheckM.contamination<3)

#bac.size <- subset(bac.size, bac.size$Assembly.Level=="Complete Genome")
#bac.size <- subset(bac.size, bac.size$Assembly.Level=="Complete Genome")

bac.size <- separate(bac.size, "Organism.Name", into=c("Genus"), sep=" ", remove = FALSE)

bac.size <- select(bac.size, Assembly.Accession, Organism.Name, Genus, Organism.Taxonomic.ID, Assembly.Stats.Total.Sequence.Length, Assembly.Level, CheckM.marker.set, Annotation.Count.Gene.Total, Assembly.Stats.GC.Percent)


gtdb.tax <-read.csv(here("00_data", "01_desc", "metadata", "GTDB", "GTDBFamilySporulation.csv"), row.names=1)



bac <- merge(bac.size, gtdb.tax, by.x="Genus", by.y="newgtdb_Genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
bac$gtdb_f[is.na(bac$gtdb_f)] <- "FAIL"

bac.good <- subset(bac, bac$gtdb_f!="FAIL")
bac.good <- select(bac.good, Assembly.Accession, Organism.Name, Genus, Organism.Taxonomic.ID, Assembly.Stats.Total.Sequence.Length, Assembly.Level, newgtdb_Domain, newgtdb_Phylum, newgtdb_Class, newgtdb_Order, gtdb_f, f_spor, Annotation.Count.Gene.Total, Assembly.Stats.GC.Percent)


bac.fail <- subset(bac, bac$gtdb_f=="FAIL")

bac.fail <- select(bac.fail, Assembly.Accession, Organism.Name, Genus, Organism.Taxonomic.ID, Assembly.Stats.Total.Sequence.Length, Assembly.Level, CheckM.marker.set, Annotation.Count.Gene.Total, Assembly.Stats.GC.Percent)

gtdb.fam <- unique(select(gtdb.tax, newgtdb_Domain, newgtdb_Phylum, newgtdb_Class, newgtdb_Order, gtdb_f, f_spor))


bac.fail <- merge(gtdb.fam, bac.fail, by.y="CheckM.marker.set", by.x="gtdb_f", all.x=FALSE, all.y=TRUE)
bac.fail$f_spor[is.na(bac.fail$f_spor)] <- "unknown"


bac.fail <- select(bac.fail, Assembly.Accession, Organism.Name, Genus, Organism.Taxonomic.ID, Assembly.Stats.Total.Sequence.Length, Assembly.Level, newgtdb_Domain, newgtdb_Phylum, newgtdb_Class, newgtdb_Order, gtdb_f, f_spor, Annotation.Count.Gene.Total, Assembly.Stats.GC.Percent)

bac.clean <- rbind(bac.good, bac.fail)

bac.clean <- subset(bac.clean, bac.clean$f_spor!="unknown")


bac.clean$genome.log <- log10(bac.clean$Assembly.Stats.Total.Sequence.Length)
bac.clean$gene.log <- log10(bac.clean$Annotation.Count.Gene.Total)
bac.clean$gene.count <- bac.clean$Annotation.Count.Gene.Total
bac.clean$GC <- as.numeric(bac.clean$Assembly.Stats.GC.Percent)

bac.stats <- select(bac.clean, Genus, Assembly.Stats.Total.Sequence.Length, newgtdb_Domain, newgtdb_Phylum, newgtdb_Class, newgtdb_Order, gtdb_f, f_spor, gene.count, GC)



bac.stats <- bac.stats %>%
  group_by(newgtdb_Domain, newgtdb_Phylum, newgtdb_Class, newgtdb_Order, gtdb_f, f_spor,) %>%
  summarise(total = n(),
    host.genome.length = mean(Assembly.Stats.Total.Sequence.Length, na.rm = TRUE) ,
    host.gene.count = mean(gene.count, na.rm = TRUE),
    host.GC = mean(GC, na.rm = TRUE))

write.csv(bac.stats, here("00_data", "01_desc", "metadata", "NCBI", "SummaryStatsBacillotaGenomes.csv"))

```
